dataset: Cosmicflows-4 group catalogue — redshift-independent distances of galaxy groups
layout: struct-of-arrays (all of field 0, then all of field 1, ...)
coordinateFrame: de Vaucouleurs supergalactic (SGL/SGB), as published in the table — no frame conversion applied. Cartesian: X = d cos(SGB) cos(SGL), Y = d cos(SGB) sin(SGL), Z = d sin(SGB).
epoch: J2000.0 (equatorial coordinates the supergalactic frame is defined against)

values.0: luminosity_distance — weighted-average distance modulus DMzp from secondary indicators (TF, FP, SBF, SNIa, SNII)
values.1: trgb_cepheid — group contains >=1 TRGB / Cepheid / maser calibrator (o_DMcal > 0); DMzp is anchored on it

distanceKind.note: All distances are luminosity distances derived from distance moduli, REDSHIFT-INDEPENDENT. They are not comoving distances and are not redshift-space positions, so this catalogue has no Fingers-of-God. CF4 is internally calibrated to H0 = 74.6 km/s/Mpc; see cosmology.json for the H0 tension note before mixing these distances with Planck-based comoving distances.

fields.name: distMpc
fields.description: Luminosity distance corresponding to DMzp (VizieR column Dist).

fields.name: pgc
fields.description: PGC id of the dominant galaxy in the group (VizieR column 1PGC). Stable identifier.

fields.name: eDMav
fields.description: Uncertainty in the average distance modulus (VizieR column e_DMav). This is the line-of-sight distance error that dominates; the renderer elongates each group radially by it instead of drawing a point. VALUE 0 MEANS NOT AVAILABLE, not "zero error": 228 records carry 0.0 in the source table and must be drawn with a fallback extent (or flagged), never as an exactly-known distance.
fields.dequantize: mag = value * 1e-4 ; fractional radial half-extent = 10**(mag/5) - 1 ; radial extent in Mpc = distMpc * (10**(mag/5) - 1)

fields.name: vcmb
fields.description: Systemic velocity in the CMB frame (VizieR column Vcmb). Independent of distMpc.

fields.name: ngal
fields.description: Number of member galaxies in the group. 1 = an ungrouped single galaxy.

fields.name: nCalibrators
fields.description: Number of member galaxies with calibrator-quality distances (o_DMcal), clamped to 255.

fractionalDistanceError.note: Derived from e_DMav; this is why groups must be drawn radially elongated.

knownSourceDefects.note: These are defects in the upstream VizieR table, reproduced here verbatim because this build does not silently correct its source. Confirmed against VizieR TAP directly.

virgoClusterSglSgb.problem: Both records are Virgo Cluster galaxies (Vcmb = 1479 km/s; PGC 41220 is the catalogue richest nearby group at Ngal = 164, Dist = 16.2 Mpc). The Virgo Cluster true supergalactic position is SGL 102.9, SGB -2.3. The SGL/SGB values above place PGC 41220 about 47 deg away and PGC 41361 about 110 deg away. PGC 41361 SGL/SGB equal M87 GALACTIC coordinates (l = 283.78, b = 74.49) to 0.16 deg, so galactic coordinates appear to have been written into the supergalactic columns for that row.
virgoClusterSglSgb.evidence: 2MRS galaxy surface density within 2 deg: 4.9x the sky average at the true Virgo position, but 0.8x and 0.2x at these two source positions, i.e. empty sky.
virgoClusterSglSgb.rendererGuidance: Do NOT render these two records at their stored SGL/SGB. Either drop them, or override to SGL 102.9 / SGB -2.3 and label the override. Distance, Vcmb and Ngal for PGC 41220 are correct and match the Virgo Cluster.
